claims.statement: Tom Allen was swindled out of a victory over Joe Goss near Cincinnati in 1876 by a fraudulent claim of foul.

fights.notes: The paper says Allen was robbed of the victory by a fraudulent foul claim, so the official result may have been a loss. It may or may not be the Goss bout described in the 1882 article printed on 16 January (644), which gives no date.
